salvageable_components.deconstruction_notes: Cut pipes at joints to separate fittings. Sort by material type (PVC/CPVC) and metal fittings for recycling.

hazard_and_diagnostic_flags: Verify presence of asbestos in joint compounds or insulation around pipes prior to dismantling.
Test for lead-based paint on metal components if building predates 1978.
Inspect boiler casing for internal corrosion or heat damage before reuse.
Check for mastic or adhesive residues on pipe joints that may require hazardous waste handling.
